about: LESSONS1 Dora/company egress deny list (plan v2.4 4.2, 12.3). A chunk matching any pattern is dropped, never sent, never logged. Every source file is screened whole, and every chunk, source path, pointer and purpose on its own; a whole-file hit drops every chunk overlapping its lines +-1. 'shapes' (ignore case) run on raw text, on normalized text (whole-string NFKC, zero-width dropped, ASCII digits) and on the normalized text with separators around '@' removed; each view unmasked, with ISO dates blanked and with letter-glued ids hidden (LESSONS1FIX3). 'words' are letters/digits only and run on the letters skeleton (normalized, casefolded, accents/Turkish/lookalikes folded, every non-letter/digit removed); '^' / '$' require a word boundary there (removed separator, lower->Upper or letter<->digit step). Bump version on any change.
